meta.title: Coach Benji Kelley | Football Coaching — Alabama
meta.description: Professional football coaching at Winfield City High School. Offensive expertise, personalized training, and real results.

about.name: Coach Benji Kelley
about.title: OC/OL
about.bio:
Coach Benji Kelley brings years of experience running the Wing-T system at Winfield City High School. With a sharp offensive mind and a track record of developing athletes who perform at the next level, Coach Kelley is known for making practice reps count.

From route running to pre-snap reads to protection schemes — Coach Kelley delivers the kind of coaching that shows up in the box score.

hero.headline: Winfield City High School's Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized offensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: Wing-T System Coaching
services.description: Installation and development of the Wing-T offense — from core concepts to advanced adjustments that put defenses in conflict.

services.title: Skill Position Development
services.description: Individual coaching for QBs, WRs, RBs, and TEs focused on technique, route running, footwork, and pre-snap reads.

services.title: Offensive Playbook & Film Study
services.description: Playbook design tailored to your personnel, plus film sessions that sharpen in-game decision making for players and staff.
